body.name: Union equilibrium-effect intervals
body.construction: For \(u,v\in V\) with \(u\ne v\), \(\mathcal I_{u\to v}:=\bigcup_{G\in\widehat{\mathcal G}_{\alpha_1}:C_G\ne\varnothing}[\inf_{(\Lambda_G,\omega)\in C_G}\tau_{u\to v}^G(\Lambda_G),\ \sup_{(\Lambda_G,\omega)\in C_G}\tau_{u\to v}^G(\Lambda_G)]\).
